subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After rebasing, should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 14 updated third-party action revisions in the privileged security, token, Codex-agent, automation, and publishing workflows?
rationale: The diff is mechanically consistent and has no identified line-level bug, but repository policy assigns several touched paths to secops and the actions execute with secrets or write and publishing permissions; accepting that supply-chain change is an owner decision.

options.title: Rebase and approve as a group
options.body: Verify every immutable revision, rerun the sensitive lanes on the rebased head, and merge the grouped update after secops and workflow-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Land ordinary setup-action bumps separately and review Codex, token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, labeler, stale, and other credentialed actions in smaller PRs.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Pause or replace this PR if owners cannot establish confidence in the combined upstream changes and credentialed workflow behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve as a group
recommendation.body: Verify every immutable revision, rerun the sensitive lanes on the rebased head, and merge the grouped update after secops and workflow-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They are strongly connected to recent central CI history and explicitly subscribed to this PR; secops and release owners should co-review their owned paths.
